d: Thousands of Haitians march through the streets of gang-infested Port-au-Prince to show their support for El Salvador's President, Nayib Bukele. Bukele's military operation in Haiti has managed to push back the gangs that have dominated the Caribbean nation for years. Meanwhile, the Philippines is showing interest in Indian weapons, mainly the BrahMos, the Akash and the Pinaka. The BrahMos is a supersonic cruise missile that India used against Pakistan during Operation Sindoor with devastating effect. Hem Saroya brings you the details on Vantage on Firstpost.
